blind_target.title: Parents’ beliefs in misinformation about vaccines are strengthened by pro-vaccine campaigns.
blind_target.evidence_quote: Next, analysis focused on participants with children, to allow comparison with Pluviano et al. (2019), who found a familiarity backfire effect in a parent sample.

luna_triage.reason: The analysis specifically selects participants with children to compare against Pluviano et al. (2019)'s reported familiarity backfire in a parent sample, and the Discussion states that parents did not show greater misinformation belief or hesitancy. This directly retests the 2019 finding. The supplied shipped Pluviano et al. (2017) paper is a distinct earlier study, not the parent-sample original.
